user.title: Connect to Halo Collar
user.description: Sign in with the email and password for your Halo account. The password is sent to Halo to get a login and is not stored.

data_description.email: The email address on your Halo account.
data_description.password: Used once to sign in. Home Assistant keeps the refresh token.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Halo Collar
reauth_confirm.description: The Halo login for {email} expired. Enter the password again.

error.invalid_auth: Halo rejected the email or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Halo. Check the network and try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong talking to Halo. Check the logs and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Halo account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: That password belongs to a different Halo account.

data.refresh_telemetry: Ask the collar for fresh telemetry

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read location and collar state. Minimum 60 seconds.
data_description.refresh_telemetry: Wakes the collar on each poll. Leave this off to use the last reported location.
